note: CONTROLLED VERIFIER TEST. These candidates are injected directly into the verifier; they are NOT scanner output. Citations are real. Two claims are true on purpose and one is false on purpose (the verifier should refute it with a mechanically checked counter-citation).

findings.title: Catch block swallows batch errors
findings.claim: The catch block in runAll swallows the failure: it logs the error but never rethrows, so callers continue as if the batch had succeeded.

findings.title: Pagination slice returns one extra item
findings.claim: items.slice(start, start + size + 1) returns size + 1 elements because slice end is exclusive, so every page leaks one item from the next page.

findings.title: Missing await before reading rotated token
findings.claim: store.save is not awaited before store.get, so the rotated token read can return the previous token and the caller receives a stale value.
